arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Seth Waxman argued the Constitution prohibits lawyers from admitting guilt over a client's objection.
Chief Justice Roberts explored scenarios where a lawyer advises a client on the best defense strategy.
Justice Breyer highlighted the danger of defendants representing themselves in capital cases.
Justice Alito summarized the defense position as prohibiting lawyers from conceding any offense element.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: the side that brought the case wants the Court to ban lawyers from admitting guilt against a client's will.
The state wants the Court to allow lawyers to admit guilt to secure a lesser sentence.
